subject: MAP kickoff: Align stakeholders and schedule kickoff with OliveTech
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@olivetech.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@olivetech.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff: Align stakeholders and schedule kickoff with OliveTech

Hi Sarah / Daniel —

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. To keep momentum toward your Q2 launch window, we'd like to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) this week to align stakeholders, confirm success criteria, and map milestones for evaluation and procurement. Proposed objectives for the kickoff:

- Introduce core project stakeholders and owners
- Review proposed evaluation plan and success metrics
- Confirm timelines for POC/test environment, security review, and procurement steps
- Agree on next milestones and owners (2–4 week cadence suggested)

Can you confirm availability for a 45-minute MAP kickoff? Here are a few slots that work for our team (PST):
- Wed Jan 21 — 9:30–10:15am
- Wed Jan 21 — 1:00–1:45pm
- Thu Jan 22 — 11:00–11:45am

I’ve copied Tessa (solutions lead) and Ava (security liaison) to make sure we bring the right folks. If you prefer a different time, let us know and we’ll adjust. I’ll circulate a short agenda and calendar hold once we lock a slot.

Attachments: OliveTech_MAP_template.xlsx (blank MAP we can fill during the call)

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@olivetech.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@olivetech.com>
Cc: procurement@olivetech.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jan 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Align stakeholders and schedule kickoff with OliveTech

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the clear agenda. Wed Jan 21 at 1:00pm PST works best for our team.

Attendees from OliveTech:
- Sarah Nguyen (Product lead)
- Daniel Park (Infrastructure/ops)
- Karen Lopez (InfoSec) — will join if available
- procurement@olivetech.com (contract lead)

A quick ask: could you include a Zoom link and a short draft agenda in the calendar invite? Also, if you have a short checklist for our security review items (SOC2 scope, data residency, audit logs), please share beforehand so Karen can prepare.

Thanks,
Sarah
Product Lead, OliveTech
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@olivetech.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@olivetech.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@olivetech.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jan 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Confirmed: MAP kickoff — Wed Jan 21 1:00pm PST (Zoom + agenda)

Great — thanks Sarah. Calendar hold is sent. Zoom link and draft agenda below. I’ve also attached a brief security checklist for Karen’s review and the MAP template for us to populate during the meeting.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=example
Google Calendar event: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=olive-tech-map-kickoff
MAP draft doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_example_MAP_draft

Draft agenda (45 min)
1) 1:00–1:05 — Intros & goals (Rishi)
2) 1:05–1:15 — High-level evaluation plan & success criteria (Sarah + Rishi)
3) 1:15–1:25 — Security & compliance checklist (Ava)
4) 1:25–1:35 — Technical integration overview & timeline (Daniel)
5) 1:35–1:40 — Procurement & contracting milestones (procurement reps)
6) 1:40–1:45 — Action items and owners (confirm MAP next steps)

Attachments: OliveTech_MAP_template.xlsx, security_checklist_onepager.pdf

See you tomorrow.

Best,
Rishi
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah@olivetech.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@olivetech.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@olivetech.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Confirmed: MAP kickoff — Wed Jan 21 1:00pm PST (Zoom + agenda)

Quick note from our side on roles for the kickoff — aiming to keep the meeting crisp:
- Rishi: project owner, drive MAP and follow-ups
- Sarah: evaluation decision-maker (product fit)
- Daniel: technical owner (integration & infra requirements)
- Ava: Redwood security/compliance lead (SOC2 scope, data controls)
- Procurement reps: contract timing and PO requirements

I’ll bring a filled-in sample MAP on the call that shows milestones through procurement to sign-off. If OliveTech prefers a longer cadence for milestones (4–6 weeks vs 2–4 weeks), we can surface that during the meeting and align.

-Tessa
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@olivetech.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah@olivetech.com>
Cc: procurement@olivetech.com, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Confirmed: MAP kickoff — Wed Jan 21 1:00pm PST (Zoom + agenda)

Thanks — join confirmed. I uploaded a draft SOW for reference (SOW_draft_v1.pdf) to the calendar event and added a brief list of our integration questions to the MAP doc.

On the security checklist: Karen confirmed she'll attend if the SOC2 summary and encryption details are in the packet; otherwise she'll ask for the checklist and come in the follow-up.

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Daniel
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, OliveTech
